headline: Approved prior meeting minutes 3-0; discussed city policy updates, supervisor training, and DPW open hours.
summary: Updates covered city policies, supervisor training, and open hours at the Department of Public Works. A Civilian Parking Enforcement Officer position is to be discussed at the request of the Pawtucket Police Department. The only recorded vote approved the minutes of the previous meeting, 3-0.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 6, 2026 meeting, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: b. Motion to approve July 6, 2026 minutes made by Will Ruggiero, 2nd by Joseph Shottek. Approved 3-0
